g.text: A 90 % interval that cannot see x/D: coverage at home and in the entrance region

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Emulator: Gnielinski, (Re, Pr) only, nothing fitted. Split-conformal interval ±19.2 % at nominal 90 %, calibrated on 40 synthetic

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: replicates of the fully developed reads (x/D ≥ 10): each curve's 8 home reads are one value, and 5 units cannot calibrate a 90 % interval (it needs 9).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: x/D is not an emulator input, so every entrance point is in-distribution. W-SURR-05 flags 45 of 45 entrance points; the input-based detectors fire on 0.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #898781
